back: Job compute is created per run and torn down, at a lower rate. All-purpose is interactive and often left running. Keyword: scheduled work uses job compute.
Its absence is the largest single source of wasted Databricks spend. Keyword: always set it.
Keep warm instances ready so cluster start-up drops from minutes to seconds. Keyword: pay to skip the wait.
Vectorised engine accelerating SQL and DataFrame work at a higher DBU rate — worth it for large scans, wasted on small jobs. Keyword: size decides.
Three levels — catalog.schema.table — with the metastore above catalogs and assigned to workspaces. Keyword: three parts.
Separate dev, test, and prod as catalogs rather than workspaces — one metastore, one permission model. Keyword: catalogs, not workspaces.
Dropping a managed table deletes the data. Dropping an external table removes only metadata. Keyword: the most consequential choice.
Surfaces another system — SQL Server, Snowflake — through a connection so it is queried without being copied. Keyword: query in place.
A view evaluates at read time and costs nothing to keep. A materialised view stores and refreshes results. Keyword: read often, change rarely.
Required on the containers above an object; missing them is why a correct-looking grant produces access denied. Keyword: traverse the path.
Granting to groups rather than individuals is what keeps the permission model maintainable. Keyword: never to people.
So a pipeline does not depend on a person's account and break when they leave. Keyword: jobs are not people.
Reaches a secret without writing it into a notebook — a credential in notebook source is visible to every repository reader. Keyword: never in the notebook.
Functions bound to a table, enforced by the engine on every query — so they cannot be bypassed by querying the table directly. Keyword: not a view.
One policy over a tag protects new tables automatically; named grants leave the next table unprotected. Keyword: scales with the estate.
What breaks if this column changes, and where did this number come from. Captured automatically at column level. Keyword: check before altering.
Shares live data read-only without copying, revoked by revoking the recipient rather than chasing copies. Keyword: no copies to chase.
Table and column descriptions are the input to AI/BI Genie; an undescribed catalog produces confident wrong answers. Keyword: governance, not documentation.
Incrementally processes files as they arrive, tracking what it has seen so listings are not repeated. Keyword: files landing continuously.
Idempotent SQL load that skips files already loaded — suits periodic loads of a known set. Keyword: idempotent.
Applies a CDC feed correctly including out-of-order events — where hand-rolled CDC usually goes wrong. Keyword: don't hand-roll CDC.
ACID transactions, schema enforcement, and time travel via the transaction log. Anything else needs a reason. Keyword: the default.
Partitioning on a high-cardinality column produces many small files and worse performance. Keyword: the classic mistake.
Supersedes partitioning and Z-order for new tables — keys can change without rewriting, and it handles skew. Keyword: not permanent.
Mark rows deleted without rewriting data files, making deletes and updates far cheaper. Keyword: reclaim later.
Adds a new row with validity dates, which is what an auditable dimension needs. Type 1 overwrites and keeps nothing. Keyword: history in rows.

front: Time travel is not history modelling
back: It is bounded by retention and table-level — not a substitute for an SCD type 2 dimension. Keyword: different job.
Records progress so a restart resumes. Sharing one between streams, or deleting it to reset, loses or duplicates data. Keyword: don't touch it.
Processes everything outstanding then stops — how a streaming source is consumed on a schedule. Keyword: batch a stream.
Bounds how long late data is accepted so streaming state does not grow without limit. Keyword: state has to end.
Depends on the merge condition pruning files; matching on a non-clustered column rewrites far more than needed. Keyword: selective condition.
Delta fails a mismatched write rather than corrupting the table. Evolution is enabled deliberately. Keyword: fail, don't corrupt.
Merge extends the schema; overwrite replaces it. Confusing them replaces a schema you meant to extend. Keyword: very different.
Warn lets rows through, drop removes them, fail stops the pipeline. A business decision, not a technical one. Keyword: three actions.
Bronze raw, silver cleansed, gold aggregated — so reprocessing is possible and a problem can be located to a layer. Keyword: keep the raw.
Declarative suits a dataset graph refreshed together; a notebook job suits procedural work with branching. Keyword: graph vs procedure.
Form a graph, so independent tasks run in parallel and a failure stops only its branch. Keyword: parallel by default.
Runs a job when files land, replacing a polling schedule. Keyword: stop polling.
Catches a job that succeeds but takes four times as long — which a failure alert never fires for. Keyword: slow is not failed.
Stops a scheduled job overlapping itself when the previous run has not finished. Keyword: prevent pile-up.
YAML defining jobs and pipelines per target environment, deployed by CLI or REST — environments identical by construction. Keyword: the deployment unit.
Uneven data across partitions — one task far slower than its peers in the same stage. Fix with AQE or salting. Keyword: one slow task.
Data written to disk because it did not fit in memory. Address with more memory, more partitions, or less per task. Keyword: memory pressure.
Broadcast the small side of a join rather than shuffling both sides across the network. Keyword: broadcast join.
Compacts small files and applies clustering — the routine fix for the small file problem. Keyword: compaction.
Exists to protect time travel and in-flight readers; lowering it to reclaim space is how both get broken. Keyword: don't shorten it.
Metrics distinguish an under-provisioned cluster from an inefficient query — resizing the latter is the expensive non-fix. Keyword: which one is it.
Billing, audit, and lineage as queryable Unity Catalog tables — so chargeback is built rather than estimated. Keyword: query your own usage.
No direct edits in a production workspace — a change made there is invisible afterwards. Keyword: promote by branch.
Makes cluster and job telemetry queryable with KQL alongside the rest of the estate. Keyword: central alerting.
